upgrades.title: Dan Upgrade List
upgrades.copy: A number of locks in the Dan system are considered upgrades of other, easier locks. You recieve points for the most difficult lock in the group.

espressoBeans.title: r/Espresso Espresso Beans Database
espressoBeans.copy: This is a sortable/searchable version of the [Espresso Beans Database](https://www.reddit.com/r/espresso/comments/1i17bed/introducing_the_respresso_coffee_bean_database_a) created by the mods of the [r/Espresso](https://www.reddit.com/r/espresso/) subreddit. This site isn't automatically updated with new entries, but we do our best to keep it up-to-date.

popularRoasters.title: Popular Roasters
popularRoasters.copy: This list is drawn from two sources: a [recent poll if the r/Pourover subreddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/pourover/comments/1pzk0aj/top_20_coffee_roasters/) and a [Top 100 Roasters of 2024](https://www.roastful.com/top-roasters) list from roastful.com. Both are subjective, but both have relatively large sample sizes. Enjoy!
